search_window.basis: Since completed_at of latest read-back-verified hourly Food Line heartbeat; evaluated event dates and original source publication dates rather than search crawl timestamps.

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Excluded donation appeals, resource guides, recipes, opinions, routine program publicity, inflation-only coverage, historic or previously observed events, and announcements without verified immediate new access loss.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new source-verified qualifying disruption found for the hourly interval. Twelve search queries returned normally and eleven examined direct source pages loaded; absence of a verified report is not proof of exhaustive nationwide absence.
